assets.prompt: Distant ancient battlefield ambience: bronze swords and shields clashing, faint disciplined battle cries, spears, marching feet and occasional arrows. No gunfire, no engines, no music, no narration.
Ancient infantry formation arriving: brief leather sandal marching steps, shield and spear equipment rattle, a quiet short horn signal. No voice or music.
Ancient stone construction: soft stone mason hammer taps, wooden beams being set, rope creaks, a few gravel movements. No power tools, music or voice.

Distant medieval battlefield ambience: steel swords and shields clashing, faint battle cries, arrows whistling, occasional horse hooves and wooden siege machinery. No firearms, engines, music or narration.
Medieval soldiers assembling: short armored marching footsteps with chainmail and shield rattles and a quiet distant horn. No speech or music.
Medieval construction workshop: quiet stone chiseling, wooden hammer taps, saw and rope creaks. No powered machinery, music or voice.

Distant Napoleonic battlefield ambience: staggered flintlock musket volleys, black powder cannon booms with long soft tails, faint soldiers shouting and horse hooves. No automatic weapons, aircraft, engines, music or narration.
Napoleonic infantry arriving: brief boots marching in formation, musket equipment and leather rattle, a quiet short bugle signal. No music bed or speech.
Napoleonic era construction workshop: hammer taps, hand saw strokes, wooden cart creaks, stonework. No modern powered machinery, music or voice.

Distant modern combined arms battlefield ambience: faint intermittent rifle and machine gun fire, occasional muffled artillery booms and low armored vehicle rumbles. Far away, subdued, no close explosions, no music or narration.
Modern military unit ready: short marching boots, equipment rattle, a soft armored engine starting and a brief quiet radio chirp. No intelligible speech or music.
Modern military construction: subdued mechanical tools and hammer taps, a brief metallic clank, low construction vehicle engine hum. No music or voice.
